rewrites.comment: React Router handles routing in the browser, so a direct visit to /products or /about must still be served index.html. Vercel checks the filesystem before applying rewrites, so real files and assets are unaffected.

headers.comment: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so they can never go stale.
Photographs keep stable names and get replaced in place, so cache for a day and revalidate rather than pinning them for a year.
